courses.overviewEn: These extensions share physics/interfaces; each identifies a boundary that prevents direct copying.

courses.summary: 本課聚焦旋轉動能、雙向電機與飛輪損耗管理。地圖提供公開研究或產業交流的背景；本課的模型和假設不宣稱在該處實測、發明或量產。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on rotational energy, bidirectional machines and flywheel loss management. The map provides public research/industry context; course models and assumptions are not claimed to have been measured, invented or manufactured there.

history.title: 跨領域研究機構成立
history.text: PNNL 官方沿革記載其成立於 1965 年。化學、材料和系統工程研究在此相連；這是儲能技術研究的代表脈絡，並非每項課程的發明地。
history.textEn: PNNL records its founding in 1965. Chemistry, materials and system engineering connect here; this is representative storage-research context, not the birthplace of every course topic.

history.title: Grid Storage Launchpad 啟用
history.text: PNNL 於 2024 年公布 Grid Storage Launchpad 啟用，連結材料研究與儲能系統驗證。課程因而把元件指標與可交付系統性能分開檢查。
history.textEn: PNNL announced the Grid Storage Launchpad opening in 2024, connecting materials research and storage-system validation. The curriculum likewise checks component metrics separately from deliverable system performance.

courses.connection: 從轉換 rpm 與角速度的課程問題出發，依來源追溯研究、元件供應與系統驗證的分工；代表地點不等於完整供應鏈。
courses.connectionEn: Start with convert rpm and angular speed and trace roles in research, components and system validation; the reference location does not represent the entire supply chain.
